newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil real closes steady in volatile trade.
newsitem.headline: Brazil real closes steady in volatile trade.

text.p: Brazil's real closed steady at 1.0512 per dollar in volatile trade on the commercial foreign exchange market, dealers said.
The real was traded between 1.0510 and 1.0520 per greenback throughout the day with players following dollar flows.
After two days of consecutive deficits in the net dollar flows, dealers were concerned about the supply of dollars in the market today.
Preliminary figures for commercial and financial foreign exchange contracts showed a Wednesday deficit of $12 million.
Dealers also said the market were expecting a lowering in the reais-dollar mini-band between 0.05 and 0.1 percent before the end of the month.
So far this month, the mini-band has been lowered 0.53 percent. In the last few months, the mini-band was lowered between 0.50 percent and 0.65 percent.
In the floating exchange rate market, the real closed at 1.0568 per dollar, down 0.04 percent.
In the illegal parallel market, the real ended steady at 1.100 per greenback, traders said.
